name: Dakshina: South Asian Language Latin & Native Script Benchmark
description: The Dakshina dataset is a collection of text in both Latin script and native scripts for 12 South Asian languages, curated by Google Research. The resource contains Wikipedia text, native-to-Latin transliterations, and lexical data, designed to support Latin script text input, script normalization, machine transliteration, and language modeling.
